title: Will It Rain?
setting: A bright living room with a large window, a television and a radio.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

sentences.en: Ben and Lily want to go to the beach.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) hold a beach ball and a bucket in the living room, looking excited.
sentences.narration: Ben and Lily hold a beach ball and a bucket in the living room, looking excited.

sentences.en: Lily looks at the gray sky through the glass.
sentences.zh: 莉莉透过玻璃望着灰色的天空。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) presses her hands against the large window glass and looks up at a cloudy gray sky, holding a bucket.
sentences.narration: Lily presses her hands against the large window glass and looks up at a cloudy gray sky, holding a bucket.

sentence_targets.en: A hard, usually transparent material used for windows and containers.

sentences.en: Ben looks in the newspaper but finds nothing.
sentences.zh: 本翻了翻报纸，但什么也没找到。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) turns the pages of a big newspaper with a puzzled face.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben puzzled over a newspaper; 'finds nothing' is only implied.
sentences.narration: Ben turns the pages of a big newspaper with a puzzled face.

sentence_targets.en: A publication containing news, articles, and advertisements, usually printed daily.

sentences.en: Lily's magazine only has pretty pictures of clothes.
sentences.zh: 莉莉的杂志里只有漂亮的衣服图片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) flips through a magazine full of pictures of dresses and shoes.
sentences.narration: Lily flips through a magazine full of pictures of dresses and shoes.

sentence_targets.en: Attractive and pleasant to look at.
A regularly published collection of articles and pictures.

sentences.en: Then they turn on the radio for the news.
sentences.zh: 然后他们打开收音机听新闻。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) turns the knob of an old radio while Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) listens closely.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the children listening to a radio; that it is the news can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Ben turns the knob of an old radio while Lily listens closely.

sentence_targets.en: information about recent events or something previously unknown
a device used to receive and play broadcast sound

sentences.en: The television news gives the same information: rain.
sentences.zh: 电视新闻给出的信息也一样：要下雨。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) watch a television showing a weather map full of rain clouds.
sentences.narration: Ben and Lily watch a television showing a weather map full of rain clouds.

sentence_targets.en: information about recent events or something previously unknown
broadcast programmes with moving pictures and sound
Facts or details about someone or something

sentences.en: "Why does it always rain?" asks Lily sadly.
sentences.zh: “为什么总是下雨呢？”莉莉难过地问。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) sits sadly on the sofa with her chin in her hands, rain on the window.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily sad about the rain; the question can only be guessed.
sentences.narration: Lily sits sadly on the sofa with her chin in her hands, rain on the window.

sentence_targets.en: used to ask about the reason for something

sentences.en: They watch a funny video or play games.
sentences.zh: 他们看搞笑视频或者玩游戏。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) laugh at a funny video on a tablet, board games on the table beside them.
sentences.narration: Ben and Lily laugh at a funny video on a tablet, board games on the table beside them.

sentence_targets.en: Used to connect alternatives or choices
A recording of moving images, usually with sound.
